marks.gloss_en: התם לאקולי בה קולא אחריתא, להתיר ראש תור היוצא הימנה -- there it comes to grant another leniency: to permit a rosh tor going out from it (Steinsaltz reads this as Rav Ashi's reply)
'go, descend, and you shall ascend' juxtaposes descent to ascent: as the ascent was early in the morning, so was the descent
he ascended early, as it is written 'and Moshe rose early in the morning and went up to Mount Sinai' (Ex 34:4)
דאי כרבי אלעזר בן עזריה -- טהורה שמענא ליה
the mishna's first clause (impure) is not R' Elazar b. Azarya's -- were it his, we heard him say 'pure'
כדאמר רב אדא בר אהבה: משה בהשכמה עלה ובהשכמה ירד -- R' Yosei's fourth-day separation began in the morning
granted REbA is like the Rabbis (separation on the fifth) and R' Yishmael like R' Yosei (on the fourth); but R' Akiva's five onot -- like whom? (ואמרי לה: Rav Pappa to Rava)
לעולם כרבי יוסי, כדאמר רב אדא בר אהבה: משה בהשכמה עלה ובהשכמה ירד (= p_ra_kerabi_yosei)
the Rabbis: [at Sinai] they made the separation on the fifth day
why did he need to tell them [in the morning]? Rav Huna said Israel are holy and do not have relations by day!
הא אמר רבא: אם היה בית אפל מותר; ואמר רבא ואיתימא רב פפא: תלמיד חכם מאפיל בטליתו ומותר (= p_bayit_afel_mutar, p_talmid_chacham_maafil)
Rav Huna: Israel are holy and do not have relations by day
the mishna: a woman who discharges semen on the third day is impure
REbA: a woman who discharges semen on the third day is pure
